channel.title: The Grant Desk - Curatorial, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Curatorial, weekly digest. Released weekly: the week's new grants arrive together on Sunday, one entry per grant plus a short roundup header, instead of trickling out daily.

item.title: 2 new Curatorial grants - week of 24 Aug 2026
item.description:
• Delfina Foundation: Open Call for Curators Based in Central and West Africa (London residency)
    https://www.delfinafoundation.com/open-calls/current/open-call-for-curators-based-in-central-and-west-africa/
    Delfina Foundation · deadline Closed 30 Aug 2026 · Fully supported: a return economy-class flight, airport transfers in the UK, reimbursement of visa fees if required, a living allowance of GBP 40 per day, a materials and research allowance of GBP 70 per week, a travel pass for London's public transport network, and a single bedroom with a desk at Delfina Foundation, a house hosting up to eight residents with shared bathrooms, laundry rooms, kitchen, library and dining room. Supported by Delfina Foundation's Network of Patrons for Africa. No application fee.
  • Scuola Piccola Zattere: International Fellowship and Residency 2027 (Venice)
    https://scuolapiccolazattere.com/en/events/internationalfellowship-2-3
    Scuola Piccola Zattere · deadline 04 Sep 2026 · EUR 5,000 fellowship grant plus a EUR 2,000 research budget, accommodation in Venice, an individual study space within a shared studio, and round-trip travel to Venice. Collectives and duos share a single grant and one accommodation. No application fee.

Full listing with filters: The Grant Desk (https://www.artificialnouveau.com/smalltools/grants/).

item.title: 1 new Curatorial grant - week of 17 Aug 2026
item.description:
• Refusing Rehearsing Resisting: VBKÖ Annual Programme Open Call 2027-2028
    https://www.vbkoe.org/en/open-call-refusing-rehearsing-resisting/
    VBKÖ (Vereinigung bildender Künstler*innen Österreichs, Austrian Association of Wom*n Artists) · deadline 10 Sep 2026 · EUR 4,000 total budget per selected project, covering both artist fees and production costs (fees, materials, labour, production, transport and other project expenses). Participants based outside Vienna must include travel, accommodation and shipping within that budget or secure external funding; VBKÖ provides invitation and support letters to help raise additional money. Also provided: the spaces and shared kitchen, graphic design of online promotional material, press announcements, photo documentation, up to 10 hours of technical setup support, and technical equipment. Installation and de-installation are the selected group's responsibility. No application fee.

Full listing with filters: The Grant Desk (https://www.artificialnouveau.com/smalltools/grants/).

item.title: 10 new Curatorial grants - week of 01 Jun 2026
item.description:
• TOKAS Curator Residency Program 2027
    https://www.tokyoartsandspace.jp/en/archive/application/2026/20260430-319.html
    Tokyo Arts and Space (TOKAS), Museum of Contemporary Art Tokyo · deadline Closed 16 Jun 2026 · Fully funded: round-trip airfare, single-room accommodation, and a project/research fee covered by TOKAS. Additional travel within Japan not covered. No application fee.
  • TOKAS Research Residency Program 2027
    https://www.tokyoartsandspace.jp/en/archive/application/2026/20260430-321.html
    Tokyo Arts and Space (TOKAS) · deadline Closed 16 Jun 2026 · Fully funded: round-trip economy airfare, accommodation in a single 25 sqm room at TOKAS Residency (49 sqm twin for duos), per-diem living expenses, plus assistance for research and public relations. No application fee.
  • IMMA Dwell Here: One Year Residency Open Call 2027
    https://imma.ie/whats-on/dwell-here-one-year-residency-open-call-2027
    Irish Museum of Modern Art (IMMA) · deadline Closed 22 Jun 2026 · Funded. Monthly EUR 1,000 bursary for pre-agreed contracted months; free onsite accommodation (separate to studio); access to an onsite IMMA studio (if required); amenities (electricity, heating, Wi-Fi, parking); one return journey for residents living outside Ireland; pre-agreed material/programming expenses related to the Research Assemblies. NOTE: EUR 10 application fee via Submittable.
  • IMMA Dwell Here: One Year Studio Residency Open Call 2027
    https://imma.ie/whats-on/dwell-here-one-year-studio-residency-open-call-2027
    Irish Museum of Modern Art (IMMA) · deadline Closed 22 Jun 2026 · Funded. EUR 4,000 bursary for the year; free access to an onsite IMMA studio; amenities (electricity, heating, Wi-Fi, parking); pre-agreed material/programming expenses related to the Research Assemblies. NOTE: EUR 10 application fee via Submittable. NO accommodation provided (apply to one of the other two Dwell Here calls if accommodation is needed).
  • IMMA Dwell Here: One Month Residency Open Call 2027
    https://imma.ie/whats-on/dwell-here-one-month-residency-open-call-2027
    Irish Museum of Modern Art (IMMA) · deadline Closed 22 Jun 2026 · Funded. EUR 250/week bursary for pre-agreed contracted weeks; free shared onsite accommodation (with own bedroom, separate to studio); access to a shared onsite IMMA studio (if required); amenities (electricity, heating, Wi-Fi, parking); one return journey for residents living outside Ireland. NOTE: EUR 10 application fee via Submittable. NOTE: cannot support accommodation for additional family members or partners.
  • A4 Residency Art Center: International Residency Programme Autumn 2027 (Chengdu)
    https://www.a4artmuseum.com/en/a4-residencyartcenter/residing/latest-recruitment/
    A4 Residency Art Center (A4 Art Museum) · deadline Closed 30 Jun 2026 · Studio and accommodation provided; round-trip economy airfare or second-class train ticket within a set budget; production grant of RMB 10,000 per person/team for creative production and material costs (excluding living expenses). No application fee.
  • Centre for Curatorial Leadership: Fellowship 2027 for Art Museum Curators
    https://on-the-move.org/news/centre-curatorial-leadership-fellowship-2027-art-museum-curators-usa
    Centre for Curatorial Leadership (CCL) (with Columbia Business School faculty) · deadline Closed 30 Jun 2026 · Tuition free. CCL covers the majority of travel, hotel and food costs for the programme: for the two weeks in NYC and the final week, the majority of meals and Mon-Fri transportation are organised by CCL (Fellows cover a small number of taxi/incidental costs); for the five-day individual residency, CCL arranges and pays for hotel and travel, and Fellows receive a daily stipend for meals, transportation and incidentals. No application fee.
  • IMPAKT: Full Spectrum Curatorship Programme 2026
    https://impakt.nl/news/2026/open-call-full-spectrum-curatorship-programme-2026/
    IMPAKT [Centre for Media Culture] · deadline Closed 07 Jul 2026 · EUR 400 participation fee. Participants receive an EUR 800 stipend during the final phase to support preparation of their final project proposal.
  • Seoul Museum of Art: Artistic Director, 14th Seoul Mediacity Biennale
    https://biennialfoundation.org/2026/06/seoul-museum-of-art-seeks-artistic-director-for-the-14th-seoul-mediacity-biennale/
    Seoul Museum of Art (SeMA) · deadline Closed 15 Jul 2026 · Compensation approximately KRW 60 million (individual) or KRW 80 million (team). The Biennale project budget is approximately KRW 2.5 billion (based on the 13th edition). No application fee.
  • A4 Residency Art Center: International Residency Programme 2028 (Chengdu)
    https://www.a4artmuseum.com/en/a4-residencyartcenter/residing/latest-recruitment/
    A4 Residency Art Center (A4 Art Museum) · deadline 31 Dec 2026 · Studio and accommodation provided; round-trip economy airfare or second-class train ticket within a set budget; production grant of RMB 10,000 per person/team for creative production and material costs (excluding living expenses). No application fee.
